termsSection1Body: LAJU is engineered as a high-assurance end-to-end encrypted communications platform for secure messaging, voice calls, video, and incident coordination for personal, enterprise, and sovereign operational security.
termsSection2Body: Your private cryptographic keys are generated and strictly stored on your physical device using hardware keystore (Secure Enclave / Android Keystore). LAJU holds no master keys and cannot recover your data without your encrypted backup.
termsSection3Body: Users agree not to exploit LAJU network infrastructure for illicit activities, malware dissemination, unauthorized network manipulation, or violations of applicable jurisdiction laws.
termsSection4Body: The architecture leverages Transactional Outbox and distributed micro-relays to guarantee high-resilience message delivery even across austere or intermittent field networks.
privacySection1Body: Chats, WebRTC calls, and media payloads are end-to-end encrypted with Double Ratchet. LAJU servers operate purely as blind routing relays and cannot decipher your plaintext content.
privacySection2Body: LAJU embeds no third-party analytics SDKs, advertising trackers, or telemetry beacons. We never commercialize or profile user identities in any form.
privacySection3Body: The mobile app enforces FLAG_SECURE protection to block screen capture of sensitive views and mask content in the system task switcher on Android and iOS.
privacySection4Body: Users maintain total control with Disappearing Messages (1h, 24h, 7d, 90d) and instant cryptographic shredding upon account deletion.

faqQ1: How does end-to-end encryption (E2EE) work in LAJU?
faqA1: All messages, photos, audio, and calls in LAJU are encrypted directly on your device using Double Ratchet Algorithm and Post-Quantum X3DH (PQ-X3DH). Private keys reside exclusively on your local hardware and are never transmitted to LAJU servers.
faqQ2: What if I forget my App Lock PIN?
faqA2: If you have enabled Biometrics (Fingerprint / Face Unlock), you can unlock the app using biometrics and reset your PIN in Settings > App Lock & Biometrics > Change PIN.\n\nIf biometrics is disabled, your identity backup phrase is required to restore access.
faqQ3: How do I backup my account and secret keys?
faqA3: Navigate to Settings > Security > Show Secret Key / Backup Identity. Authenticate with biometrics/PIN to view your 24-word recovery phrase. Store it securely offline.
faqA4: Account Trust Score is a reputation system to protect the LAJU ecosystem from spam and fraudulent activity. New accounts start with 100 points. If an account is reported with valid reasons verified by reviewers, points are deducted. Accounts with low trust scores face rate limits on sending messages to non-contacts.
faqQ5: How do encrypted voice and video calls work?
faqA5: Calls in LAJU use WebRTC P2P (Peer-to-Peer) architecture protected by DTLS-SRTP encryption. Audio and video streams flow directly between endpoints without plaintext transit through servers.
faqQ6: How do I report a suspicious or abusive contact?
faqA6: Open the conversation with the contact, tap their profile name at the top to view details, then select "Report User". Select the appropriate category (Spam, Harassment, Scam) and provide details.
faqQ7: Does LAJU server store message history?
faqA7: No. LAJU operates under a strict Zero-Knowledge Architecture. The server serves solely as a temporary outbox relay. As soon as a message is delivered to the recipient device, it is permanently erased from the server relay memory.
faqQ8: How do I transfer my account to a new phone (Device Migration)?
faqA8: On your old phone, open Settings > Account > Device Migration. Scan the QR code shown on your new phone using the LAJU camera scanner. All encryption keys and sessions are transferred securely peer-to-peer.

privacySec1Body: LAJU does not require, collect, or store your phone number, email address, national identity card, or real name. Your account identity is purely anchored in cryptographic keypairs (Ed25519 & X25519) generated locally inside your device hardware security module.
privacySec2Body: LAJU servers operate solely as blind routing relays. All chats, WebRTC calls, and media attachments are end-to-end encrypted with Double Ratchet. Upon successful delivery to recipient devices, packets are instantly and permanently erased from relay memory and database. LAJU stores no message history in the cloud.
privacySec3Body: Identity private keys, session ratchets, and encryption PINs remain strictly isolated within hardware-backed security modules (Android Keystore / StrongBox / Apple Secure Enclave). Private keys never leave your physical device and are never transmitted over the network.
privacySec4Body: LAJU does not sell, track, or share user data. Contacts are added via public cryptographic username or QR code, never by scanning or uploading your address book. Timestamps and routing tokens are processed strictly in-memory for instant packet delivery and are never monetized.
privacySec5Body: You retain absolute ownership of your data. You can activate Disappearing Messages or permanently delete your account at any time via Settings > Account > Delete Account, which instantly shreds local cryptographic keys and invalidates public keys from directory relays.
termsSec1Body: LAJU requires no phone number, no email address, and no government ID. You access the service exclusively using a local cryptographic keypair. By using LAJU, you agree to utilize the platform responsibly in compliance with all applicable laws in your jurisdiction.
termsSec2Title: 2. Sole Custody of Keys & Device Security
termsSec2Body: Because LAJU operates with zero-knowledge architecture and decentralized identity, you hold sole custody of your device PIN and backup identity keys. LAJU cannot recover your account or decrypt your communications if your local keys are lost.
termsSec3Body: Users are strictly prohibited from utilizing LAJU for unsolicited bulk messaging (spam), financial fraud, malware dissemination, harassment, or illegal exploitation. Violations will result in cryptographic public key suspension from relay nodes.
termsSec4Body: You retain 100% intellectual property ownership of all messages, media, and files transmitted. LAJU claims no ownership, does not monetize your content, and does not serve advertisements.
termsSec5Body: LAJU empowers users with granular data lifecycle controls: recall sent messages, activate disappearing message timers, or perform emergency data wipes. Expired or wiped data is unrecoverable by design.
termsSec6Body: We strive to maintain a 99.99% relay availability SLA via transactional outbox architecture. The service is provided as-is without warranties regarding third-party telecom or internet transit interruptions.
